protocol.phase: final untouched-seed evaluation; no tuning after freeze
protocol.observation: unchanged public observe(); all actors see the same world tick
protocol.execution: One Node process; each entrant compiled once and each match uses a new VM context; serial decisions under formal elapsed-time budget
protocol.order: At each seed all five pairs run; pair order cyclically rotates by seed index; each pair uses both spawn rotations
protocol.eventRetention: All death, pickup and shield events; per-player shots retained; individual fire events and trace windows omitted
